## v0.3.2 — Multi-sensor lens analytics

Multi-sensor cameras (such as 4-lens Hanwha PNM-C models) are now first-class on the dashboard. Previously a multi-sensor appeared as a single opaque camera, and per-lens zones that shared a name could be mis-attributed to the wrong role.

### What's new
- **Per-lens analytics.** Events now carry which camera lens (sensor) they came from, so each lens's zones, roles, and metrics are tracked independently. A multi-sensor that reuses the same zone name across lenses no longer collapses them into one.
- **New Multi-Sensor view.** A dedicated page (sidebar → **Multi-Sensor**) shows each lens of a multi-sensor camera side by side — its zone map (with roles) and an activity chart scoped to just that lens.
- **Lens-aware dashboard cards.** A dashboard card's source selector now expands a multi-sensor camera into its individual lenses, so you can scope a tile to one sensor.

### Fixes
- A dashboard card's camera/lens + time-window selection now **saves immediately and survives a refresh** — previously a change could silently revert.
- Zone-role tiles (e.g. **Entrance Flow**) on a multi-sensor camera now show the correct data instead of appearing empty.

No action is required. Existing dashboards keep working and single-sensor cameras are unaffected; per-lens history for multi-sensor cameras rebuilds automatically after the upgrade.
